DESIGN_REASONING: A reaches the 0.80 power target at q = 0.40 with 150 primary worlds where B needs 256, and it delivers a strictly stronger causal contrast because the arms share the exact pre-intervention state. B was not retained merely because SPOIQ01 proposed it.

PRIMARY_NULL.WHY_0.05_IS_NOT_ARBITRARY: the frozen R2 material criterion D compares the daughter's post-intervention local X against the exact 95 per cent binomial upper bound on how much pre-intervention X could survive T_HOLD steps with no new production. Under NO_NEW_DAUGHTER_X_PRODUCTION the false-positive probability of criterion D is therefore bounded by 0.05 by construction. The null is the criterion's own false-positive rate, not a chosen number.
PRIMARY_NULL.critical_function: critical(M) = smallest k with P[Binomial(M,0.05) >= k] <= 0.05

TRIGGER.definition: the FIRST step at which an episode of exactly two spatial centres reaches its frozen FDFLT01 maturation event
TRIGGER.exact_step: run_start + 250 - 1, evaluated at EXACTLY that step and not at later steps of the same run
requires: no third centre inside the episode window
the weaker centre's local X mass at the event is at least f_primary of the stronger's
TRIGGER.does_NOT_require: R1. R1 is classified separately at t_m so the intervention can never be delayed until a favourable provenance state appears.

PRIMARY_ENDPOINT.LATE_TRIGGER_RULE: a functional daughter appearing after the latest allowed trigger is a population-level FAILURE and is NOT intervention-eligible; the count is reported explicitly. No world is extended adaptively.
PRIMARY_ENDPOINT.INTERVENTION_BOUNDARY: after the completed end-of-step observation at t_m and before the first transport of t_m + 1. The engine never detects maturation and never invokes the intervention.

R1_EXACT.basis: molecule identity from the engine's inert tracker
R1_EXACT.criterion: inherited_mass_in_daughter_disc < f_primary * parent_disc_mass — the counterfactual F5 asks, restricted to material that existed before the daughter did

R2_EXACT.A: the daughter Y centre still exists
R2_EXACT.E: the tracker shows post-intervention X births inside the surviving daughter disc
R2_EXACT.E_is_load_bearing: criterion E converts the test from 'old stock survived' to 'the daughter maintained production'

PRIMARY_ENDPOINT.THIRD_CENTRE_RULE: a third spatial centre appearing before R2 completion is a PRIMARY_REPRODUCTION_FAILURE, frozen before runs, because the causal source of maintained X would otherwise be ambiguous
PRIMARY_ENDPOINT.POST_INTERVENTION_WINDOW: exactly T_HOLD steps with NO early stop. Extinction and third-centre events are recorded as OUTCOMES, not used as stops, because the GLOBAL arm removes all Y by design and must still be observed decaying. Frozen here, before any world exists.
PRIMARY_ENDPOINT.MINIMAL_REPRODUCTION: R0 and R1 and R2 in the predeclared temporal order

ARMS.A_SELECTIVE_PARENT_OFF: remove only parent-centre Y, exactly to WY; daughter untouched; no RNG
ARMS.B_SHAM: the identical experimental branch and audit record with an empty mask; controls the trigger and intervention machinery
ARMS.C_GLOBAL_ORGANISER_OFF: the historical global Y->WY transformation, applied at the identical boundary through the same three-line operation with an all-true mask; a frozen fixture proves state-identity with the historical organiser_off_at path

CONTROL_DESIGN.WHY_NO_SECOND_GLOBAL_MECHANISM: the all-true mask reproduces the historical transformation exactly; applying it at the same boundary as A and B is what makes the paired comparison valid, and the equivalence is proven by fixture rather than asserted
CONTROL_DESIGN.PAIRING: all three arms of a block share one seed and are forked from one bit-identical pre-intervention state
CONTROL_DESIGN.PRE_INTERVENTION_MATCHING_GATE: physical state hash and RNG fingerprint must be identical across the three arms before the intervention; any mismatch is a technical failure of the design and is not repaired after outcomes
CONTROL_DESIGN.NOT_REQUIRED: SELECTIVE need not equal SHAM; parent removal is supposed to be a perturbation

CLAIM_CEILING: minimal reproduction under R0+R1+R2 at the frozen B1 law. Not strong self-reproduction, not second-generation competence, not heredity, not evolution, not life.
